what: Rejected-count grep requires a colon the tally writer never emits
scenario_or_breakage: Every design plan-review round records rejected=0 in ledger/committed timing JSON while accepted/OOS look correct
suggested_fix: Use `grep -cE '^### \[Plan Review\] FINDING_[0-9]+$'` (or `^### FINDING_[0-9]+:` on `rejected-findings.md` only); add a fixture/assert in `scripts/test-timing-report.sh`
